A room for sitting with hard questions: the Library on the walls, a circle of chairs in the middle, meetings on the calendar. The 11-chair Council Chamber scene is being designed (see the backlog); until it's built this lists the Library and the discussion/meeting practice honestly.
heading: A room for sitting with hard questions
intro: The Library stands on all four walls; a circle of chairs sits in the middle — eleven, with room for more around them — for members to sit and think out loud together. Meetings are set on the calendar. Read, then talk.
protocol_default: Want to go deeper on something? Read what's on the walls (the Library), then bring it to the circle — post in the room, or set a meeting. Members who think about a given question are listed below as they say so.

studios.title: The Library on the walls
studios.what: The papers, traditions and the project's own writing on consciousness, choice, and how to live well together. The four walls of the room.

studios.title: The circle of chairs
studios.what: Where the talking happens: a ring of eleven chairs with outer seats for everyone else. Discussions run here; meetings are scheduled.
studios.use_note: The spatial 11-chair Council Chamber scene is being designed (on the backlog). For now the circle is the room's chat and its scheduled meetings.
